id: title:hpouillot:prevent stale issue reloads after merge

review.posthog_relevance: Frontend error tracking and issue management UX, specifically the Error Tracking issue scene and its associated actions.
review.reason: The change removes unused imports and a prefetch helper, and adds client-side state management for concurrent merge operations and issue-specific mutation handling. This improves the reliability and responsiveness of the Error Tracking UI by preventing race conditions and unnecessary rendering, but lacks backend or shared dependency changes, limiting systemic benefit.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is localized to the client-side implementation and does not demonstrate broader systemic improvements or backend dependency changes. No tier assignment was performed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Removes unused import of errorTrackingIssueSceneLogic and its usage in ErrorTrackingIssueList and TableColumns, removing the prefetchIssueScene helper and its onClick handler.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes a client-side prefetch pattern that could have caused unnecessary scene mounts or stale state, potentially reducing unnecessary navigation or rendering. No backend or shared state dependency is removed, so this is a localized cleanup.

observations.behavior: Adds mergeInFlight state and its use to disable the merge button and show loading state; also adds a test for the merge outcome.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a loading state and disables the merge button while a merge is in progress, preventing concurrent merges and improving UX. This could reduce race conditions or duplicate requests. No backend change is shown, so benefit is limited to this client-side safeguard.

observations.behavior: Adds an explicit issueId parameter to the mutationFailure and mutationSuccess action type signatures and their implementations, and adds a new splitIssueSuccess action.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Error Tracking issue scene to distinguish between mutations affecting the current issue versus unrelated mutations, and to execute issue-specific refresh and event-loading actions only when the mutation targets this issue.
